t: Paragraph (2) of section 987(i) of title 10, United States Code, is amended to read as follows:“(2) Dependent.—The term ‘dependent’, with respect to a covered member, means a person described in subparagraph (A), (D), (E), or (I) of section 1072(2) of this title.”.

fable.w: This section only amends a statutory definition of 'dependent' by cross-reference to another provision. There is no tempting reading here: it creates no consultation, comment period, rulemaking, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.
fable.s: The term ‘dependent’, with respect to a covered member, means a person described in subparagraph (A), (D), (E), or (I) of section 1072(2) of this title.

qwen_block.w: This section is a purely definitional amendment to the United States Code. It defines the term 'dependent' for legal purposes but does not establish any process for consultation, public comment, advisory boards, or coordination with outside parties. There is no interaction with non-federal entities involved in a decision-making process.

opus.w: The section only amends the definition of "dependent" in 10 U.S.C. 987(i)(2) by cross-referencing section 1072(2). It requires no consultation, public comment, hearing, rulemaking, advisory committee, or right to sue. It mentions covered members and dependents, but it gives no outside party any role in a federal decision.
